$sources: ACI 318-19 Chapter 25 (reinforcement details) and Sec 24.3 (crack control)
source: ACI 318-19 Chapters 18, 24 and 25 (SI values of ACI 318M-19)

sources.skin: ACI 318-19 9.7.2.3: h > 900 mm, both side faces over h/2 from the tension face, spacing by 24.3.2
sources.flangeTension: ACI 318-19 24.3.4: flange tension steel over the effective width or ln/10; 6.3.2.1, Table 6.3.2.1: overhang <= 8 hf and ln/8 each side (both sides; taken as bf <= span/4 overall), <= 6 hf and ln/12 (one side); sw/2 not checked
sources.integrity: ACI 318-19 9.7.7.1: perimeter beams at least 1/4 of the largest positive and 1/6 of the negative steel at the support, each at least two bars, continuous; 9.7.7.2: other beams at least 1/4 of the positive steel, two bars, or closed stirrups
sources.shearFriction: ACI 318-19 22.9.4.2, Table 22.9.4.2: μ = 1.4 λ monolithic, 1.0 λ roughened (6 mm), 0.6 λ not roughened, 0.7 λ to as-rolled steel; Table 22.9.4.4: Vn <= min(0.2 f'c, 3.3 + 0.08 f'c, 11) Ac (monolithic or roughened, normal weight), else min(0.2 f'c, 5.5) Ac; Table 20.2.2.4(a): fy <= 420 MPa; 22.9.4.6: permanent net compression additive
sources.tendonSpacing: ACI 318-19 24.3.2.2-24.3.2.3: bonded tendons at most 2/3, bars and tendons at most 5/6 of the Table 24.3.2 spacing; Δfps in place of fs, at most 250 MPa; up to 140 MPa no check
sources.special: ACI 318-19 18.6.2.1 (beams: ln >= 4d, width >= 0.3 h and 250 mm), 18.6.3.1 (ρ <= 0.025), 18.7.2.1 (columns: least dimension >= 300 mm, ratio >= 0.4), 18.7.4.1 (0.01 <= ρ <= 0.06), 18.7.5.2(e) (hx <= 350 mm), 18.6.4.4 (first hoop 50 mm from the face), Table 20.2.2.4(a) (confinement fyt <= 690 MPa)
sources.special.columnSpliceDivisor: ACI 318-19 18.7.4.3 with 18.7.5.3(a): the lap splices of special moment frame columns enclosed by the end zones' transverse reinforcement, whose spacing is at most the least dimension / 4 (the parent's 4)
sources.special.columnSpliceCap: ACI 318-19 18.7.4.3: no fixed cap of its own (the parent's 100 mm is BNBC 2020 Figure 6.8.8's); the spacing is capped by 18.7.5.3 through columnSpliceZone
sources.special.columnSpliceZone: ACI 318-19 18.7.4.3: the lap splices enclosed within transverse reinforcement in accordance with 18.7.5.2 and 18.7.5.3, the spacing of the end zones (least dimension / 4, 6 db, so)
sources.bars.splices.hoopDepthShare: ACI 318-19 18.6.3.3: the transverse reinforcement enclosing the lap-spliced bars of special moment frame beams at most d / 4 (the parent's 0.25)
sources.bars.splices.hoopMax: ACI 318-19 18.6.3.3: and at most 100 mm (the parent's)
sources.joints: ACI 318-19 18.8.2.1 (T = 1.25 fy As), 18.7.3.2 (ΣMnc >= 1.2 ΣMnb), 18.7.3.1 (Pu > 0.1 Ag f'c), Table 18.8.4.3 (γ: 1.7, 1.2, 1.0 at joints of continuous columns; 1.2, 1.0, 0.7 where the column does not continue above ('Top' keys)), 18.7.6.2.1 (Vc = 0 below Pu = 0.05 Ag f'c)
sources.walls: ACI 318-19 18.10.2.1 (0.083 λ √f'c Acv relaxes ρ), 18.10.2.2 (two curtains above 0.17 λ √f'c Acv or where hw/lw >= 2.0), 18.10.6.2 (boundary elements: c >= lw / (600 (1.5 δu/hw)), δu/hw >= 0.005), 18.10.6.3 (0.2 f'c, 0.15 f'c), 18.10.3.3 (Ve = Ωv ωv Vu <= 3 Vu: Ωv = 1.5 for hwcs/lw > 1.5, ωv = 0.9 + ns/10 up to 6 storeys, 1.3 + ns/30 <= 1.8 above, 1.0 for hwcs/lw < 2.0), 18.10.7.4 (coupling beams), 18.10.8.1 and 2.3 (wall piers); Table 20.2.2.4(a) (690 MPa)
sources.lintels: SAEngine lintel design practice (bearing 100 mm minimum, 150 mm used; span/600; 1.25 fy probable stress per ACI 318-19 18.6.5.1)
sources.spacing: ACI 318-19 25.2.1 (layer: db, 25 mm and 4/3 dagg), 25.2.2 (between layers: 25 mm), 25.2.3 (columns: 1.5 db and 40 mm)
sources.bars: ACI 318-19 25.3 (hooks and bends, Tables 25.3.1, 25.3.2), 25.4 (development, Tables 25.4.2.3, 25.4.2.5, Eq 25.4.2.4a, 25.4.3.1, 25.4.9.2), 25.5 (splices, Table 25.5.2.2, 25.5.5.1), 25.7.3.6 (spiral laps), 18.6.3.3 and 18.7.4.3 (splice zones of special frames), 9.7.3 (bar extents), 8.7.4.1.3 (slab top bars), 18.10.2.3 (special wall laps)
